person[taxpayer].ira_line11.remedy: Nonqualified deferred compensation in box 1 (Form W-2 box 11 or code Z, Form 1099-MISC box 15), fellowship or stipend payments not on a Form W-2, repayments of qualified reservist distributions and difficulty of care payments change the IRA compensation or contribution limits; they are outside this tool.

cite.locator: p. 95, Line 20, "don’t include that income on line 8 of the worksheet" and "Don’t include any repayments of qualified reservist distributions"; p590a p. 6, What Is Compensation?, "certain non-tuition fellowship and stipend payments not reported to you on Form W-2 are treated as taxable compensation for IRA purposes"
